The ride is posted on the group's Meetup page; RSVP there. The host's only promise on pace is that nobody gets dropped. Bike type isn't stated, so ask on the Meetup event if you're unsure. The group also holds a monthly happy hour.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
"Can be fast, can be slow" in the host's words. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Sunday Social Ride group ride

Sunday Social Ride is a social group ride in Chandler, AZ. It rolls every Sunday at 6:00 am from Panera Bread (formerly Paradise Bakery).

A weekly Sunday-morning social ride out of a Panera on Germann Road in southeast Chandler. The host's one line on pace: it can be fast, it can be slow, and there is a no-drop promise. Run through the Southeast Chandler Cycling Meetup group, which has about 1,600 members.
